Published hours. A sample week.

Dots represent mapped public-service addresses; one address can contain several service counters with different hours. The counter counts service-location records, not unique buildings. Tap a dot to see each service.

Open means within published regular service hours—not an available appointment, guaranteed entry, or enough time to finish a visit. Special-date sessions, holidays and intake cutoffs can change access. Unknown schedules are excluded from the open/closed denominator. Permanently closed listings are omitted.

The 9–5 weekday work band is an example, not a claim about everyone. Sun and moon are illustrative, not actual sunrise times. This is a partial inventory, not all NYC public services.

Coordinates are automated matches to NYC Planning’s address service, screened for house number, borough and confidence. Locations may need correction. Unmatched addresses are excluded from the map.
